name: École Militaire
type: military school; military academy; building complex; military training unit
text: The École Militaire (French: [ekɔl militɛːʁ] ; lit. 'military school') is a complex of buildings in Paris, France, which house various military training facilities. It was founded in 1751 by King Louis XV and is located in the 7th arrondissement of Paris, southeast of the Champ de Mars.

depictions.name: Ecole Militaire
depictions.text: The École Militaire (English: Military School) is a large complex of buildings housing military training facilities in Paris.
